name: A Midnight Vending
source:
an office worker stuck in routine

an escapee from a lab

come to the same sanctuary

bonding over cans of soft drinks

[From [url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/a-midnight-vending]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个被日常困住的上班族，

一个逃出实验室的人，

来到同一个避风港，

就着几罐汽水，渐渐熟络起来。

［摘自[url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/a-midnight-vending]itch.io[/url]］
